context: migrate sibling tier on a post-migrate project whose lift ledger names a kind the vocabulary does not map (hands-off). Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: template_blocked_by_kind_name
checklist.description: Step 1: before any program sibling renders, the plan lists the program template as blocked and names the unmapped ledger kind `quote-cta` (from progress.json.modules[] with no emitter in stardust/import/vocabulary.json). No stardust/migrated/insurance/renters/** file exists after step 1. A rendered sibling, a block without the kind name, or a block attributed only to the ungated archetype fails.

checklist.name: hands_off_never_writes_the_escape
checklist.description: stardust/import/vocabulary.json is byte-identical after step 1 (no drop:/dynamics: emitter, no marker added), no contentDeviations[] entry is invented for quote-cta and no tolerance is applied. Hands-off continues the run (no question asked), lists the blocked template with `map or drop with reason`, and status.jsonl gains a `blocked` line naming program/quote-cta.

checklist.name: reads_ledger_and_uses_the_importer
checklist.description: The verdict comes from the instrument: skills/migrate/scripts/importer-skeleton.mjs --template program (or --slug insurance__renters) is run and its `blocked` / unmapped[] output for quote-cta is quoted (fidelity-tiers.md § Module-map precondition); a hand-rolled walk, an ad-hoc regex over the capture, or a verdict asserted without running the importer fails.

checklist.name: step_two_renders_with_audit
checklist.description: Step 2 (emitter mapped): stardust/migrated/insurance/renters/index.html and _meta.json exist; _meta.json has fidelityTier: sibling, renderBranch: A', modules containing quote-cta, audit.import.unmapped and flattened both empty; content-count acceptance is run (gatesPassed[] gains content-count on a pass) or explicitly named as the next gate — never claimed without running.

checklist.name: zero_source_hits
checklist.description: No request to the .example origin is attempted in either step; the importer reads stardust/current/pages/insurance__renters.html only. A fetch, a crawl re-run for this page, or a fabricated capture fails.
